# Robust Sync experimental comparison build

This branch packages Windows/TV 0.6.0-beta.1 and phone 0.1.1-beta.1. It preserves earlier app profiles and TV installations. Choose Original timing, Video servo or Audio clock on Connect while disconnected; each mode saves its own offset. Test at zero lead before optional phone measurement and Apply. Receiver inspection reports settings/declarations without inventing total processing latency.

Original media and TrueHD audio remain untouched. Improved physical lip-sync, real TV/phone/S95TR behavior and Windows native inspection still need hardware acceptance. Follow docs/robust-sync.md in the source archive. This local branch is not merged or published; the workflow's publishing job remains restricted to main.
